subject.title: Proof stack for generated media wake-false fallback

question: Should this draft stack remain a proof-only target for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97275 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97308, or should maintainers accept one combined landing boundary after live proof succeeds?
rationale: The PR body says the final split should remain separate, but the branch combines both changes plus stack-only glue and the only live proof attempt skipped both sides, so automation cannot decide the merge boundary or proof sufficiency.

options.title: Keep As Proof-Only Target
options.body: Use the stack to get a successful Telegram Desktop baseline/candidate artifact, then land or close the split PRs separately.

options.title: Accept Combined Landing
options.body: Merge this stack only if maintainers intentionally want the production fallback and proof harness to land together with the stack-only alignment code.

options.title: Pause Or Close The Stack
options.body: Close or pause this draft if the proof runner cannot exercise the generated-image marker path and continue review on the split PRs.

recommendation.title: Keep As Proof-Only Target
recommendation.body: Use the stack to get a successful Telegram Desktop baseline/candidate artifact, then land or close the split PRs separately.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is mostly about Telegram/Mantis proof coverage and landing boundary, and Vincent Koc has the strongest recent history on the proof-runner side.
